containment.zero_definition: Unsupported in this draft, not absolutely impossible
containment.heuristic_notes: At matching effective scales, either direction can be valid if semantically plausible. Across different effective scales, larger->smaller is default, with explicit credible inverse scenarios. Faction may promote uncommon positive relations, but not force clearly incoherent pairs.

semantics.containment: A parent may physically contain, encompass, attach, or integrate a child into one real geographic complex; explicit scale interpretation may permit reverse pair
semantics.reciprocal: Two independent alternative scope interpretations, not a cycle in one generated world
